isletGardener: These lettuces are fresher than I am. And I've done absolutely nothing all day.
isletHarbor: The ferryman says there's no splashing. Easy to say from the dry end.
isletHome: My house used to be a flowerpot. Cheap rent: two seeds and a promise to water it.
isletHammock: I'm safety-testing the hammock. Three naps in, still not ready to sign it off.
isletFlowers: The flowers aren't snacks, mate. Just saying, with that look on your face.
title: The Magikitos Adventure
description: A forest, a little elf, and all the time in the world.
noScript: Enable JavaScript to step into the woods.
loadError: The woods could not open. Reload the page to try again.
blocked: Can’t squeeze through there. I’ll try another way.
night: Stories make the night last here.
neighborGreeting: I went out to do nothing. So far, so good.
world: A little world. A big adventure.
missingMedia: This audio isn’t available right now. Try another.
author: Voice shared by
hint: Tap to go, drag to look around, pinch to zoom. Arrows/WASD to move; hold space to run or row faster.
noPooping: “No pooping here”... yeah, right! When nature calls, I know exactly where I'm heading.
tavernTable: This is where bad jokes get told twice. In case you missed how bad they were.
humanBed: An elf bed. Soft blankets and room to hide crumbs. Five stars.
humanTable: Twig furniture, acorn crockery. Small plates, big conversations.
empty: There’s room for plenty more stories here.
workshopDialogue: Magikitos are born here, one by one, made by hand. Mine says his hair just grew like that. I didn’t ask.
usePrompt: Using :item · Tap an object in the world
noUse: That doesn’t look like a great combination. My insurance doesn’t cover experiments.
reusable: Reusable tool · Stays in your sack
bagEmpty: One bit of fluff. So much potential. Let’s find something.
lighterDescription: Borrowed beside the smoking picnicker. Makes sparks and stays with you.
mushroomDescription: A tidy piece cut with the pocketknife. Ready for the barbecue.
fireLit: It's lit! And all my eyebrows are intact. The coals are ready for a skewer.
forestDirections: Humans are picnicking to the north. Elf homes across the bridge. Stories and a warm fire by the lake.
humanDrawers: Thread, seeds and borrowed odds and ends. Nothing goes to waste.
cottageBed: A bed inside a stump. No rent, birds included.
ambientGarden: I’m watching the grass grow. So far, it’s winning.
ambientHat: My hat isn’t crooked. It’s thinking sideways.
ambientLake: I came to listen to the water. It hasn’t asked me for any favors yet.
ambientHunger: That rumbling? Bramble by the barbecue. His tummy sounds like a thunderstorm.
contentInItsPlace: Discover this in its own corner of the world.
picnicHungry: I'm bloody starving... reckon you could make me a mushroom skewer?
picnicSmellsGood: That smell… Is it for me? I promise to chew. At least the first two times.
picnicThanks: Cracking skewer! Here’s :reward setines and my old oars. Find something that floats, make a little boat and go see what’s upriver!
picnicAfter: Lovely stuff. Give me five hours to digest. Not even a crumb would fit right now.
twigDescription: A sturdy twig. A skewer today; with a broad leaf, an oar tomorrow.
skewerDescription: Golden grilled mushroom. The barbecue neighbour keeps glancing over.
picnicMushroom: Lovely chunk for a skewer. That’ll do nicely!
picnicTwig: What a top-tier stick! I'll make a skewer so good even the mayor will lose it.
picnicLighter: Lighter in the bag! Ha, Mr Cigarette hasn't noticed a thing. Might help him quit.
barbecueHint: This barbecue's dead as a fart. Needs lighting. Where can I nick a spark?
skewerReady: Fire, mushroom, stick and knife. Step aside, woodland chef coming through!
skewerNeedTwig: Now that's a proper fire. Time to find a stick for a cracking skewer.
skewerNeedMushroom: Lovely fire, stick ready. I'll grab a mushroom and sort our mate out.
skewerCooked: Skewer bagged! Golden, glorious, frankly chef's-kiss stuff. Let's sort Brizno's rumbling belly.
barbecueAfter: Already got a skewer in the sack. Let's share it before grilling another.
shellDescription: A handful of shells. Someone on the islet could use them.
shellRequest: I make shell buttons, mate. Bring a handful from the east shore and I'll pay :price setines. Always happy to buy more!
shellFound: Shells for the neighbour. Not one complained about the trip into the sack.
shellOffer: How lovely! May I have them for my buttons?
shellThanks: Lovely shells! Here's :price setines. The shore keeps bringing more if you fancy earning a bit extra.
isletBench: Water everywhere and not a meeting in sight. This bench has potential.
isletGreeting: I came to watch the waves. Haven't seen them all yet.
walletLocal: Adventure test balance. Does not change your account's setines.
travelError: Couldn't prepare the trip. Your items and setines are safe. Please try again.
needPoop: Need a poo. Urgent bottom business.
needLeaf: Hmm… first I need a leaf to wipe my little bum.
noNeed: Nothing brewing right now. Back to exploring!
poopIncludesPee: This calls for a squat, mate. Two jobs in one!
peeDone: Aaah… that's better. Back to my very busy day of wandering.
poopDone: What a relief! One leaf used, bum all tidy.
leafDescription: Big, soft and never prickly. One leaf is used to wipe after each poo.
leafFound: Perfect leaf for wiping my bum after dropping a log... in the bag you go!
leafFull: 99 leaves! You're carrying a paper shop, mate.
fountainWish: One setin, one wish. If it takes two, I'm asking to speak to the fountain's manager.
campBench: A bench by the fire. Lovely. Even my to-do list can take the night off.
lakeBench: Water, shade and a bench. Someone's got the right idea.
outsideToClose: Tap outside to return to the world · Esc
identityTooMany: Too many around here right now. Try again in a while.
voteError: Couldn’t save that. Give it another go.
searchHint: What would you like to find?
contentUnavailable: No news from the village just now. Keep exploring!
guardianIntro: Hey! What can you tell me about “:term”?
guardianError: The keeper’s lost in thought. Try again.
guardianPrivacy: Sending saves this chat and creates your Magikitos corner if you don’t have one yet.
knifeDescription: Borrowed beside the picnic tortilla. Slices mushrooms and never gets used up.
mushroomEnough: We've got enough for one skewer. No need to strip the whole forest.
picnicKnife: That's a tidy little knife those two have. I'll borrow it. Just the job for chopping mushrooms.
humanSmoker: He's busy with his cigarette. His lighter's beside the blanket. How conveniently forgetful.
humanPicnicFriend: They've packed enough for an army. Meanwhile, I could hide behind the basket.
tortillaLook: A potato tortilla the size of a village square! The little knife beside it looks handy.
picnicDirections: Human picnic, this way. Don't spook them: they squeal louder than we do.
picnicThanksAgain: Another lovely skewer! You've made my day. Time for a nap. Watching you cook was exhausting.
picnicHungryAgain: There goes my belly again, kicking up a right fuss. Another skewer, legend?
barbecueLightReady: Got a lighter. Go on, give it some fire! Staring at it won't cook dinner.
skewerNeedKnife: Need a little knife for that mushroom. Bet there’s one around the picnic.
fountainPoor: Business is rough. Can't even afford a bloody wish!
fountainThanks: Plink! There goes my setin. Don't pretend you didn't hear me, fountain.
riverMemory: What a river! As a kid I sailed it every day. Half a bottle, two little sticks with leaves… off I went!
bottleDescription: Empty and light… just enough room for a resourceful duende.
bottleFound: A bottle! One careful cut and a couple of oars… that's a boat in the making.
binReminder: Rubbish belongs in here, mate. Not on the ground.
bottleBoatDescription: Half a bottle and the old chap’s oars. No tickets: the river belongs to everyone.
boatRecipe: A bottle, your knife and Brizno’s oars. No oars yet? That hungry old chap might need a hand.
boatReady: Now that's a boat! Keep your knife. If the current sweeps you away, find calm water and try another line.
dockReady: Your boat’s ready. Walk to the end of a jetty to launch; paddle towards a jetty to hop out. Off you go!
riverNoRoute: The boat won't fit there. Try open water.
homeArrival: Whoa, what a spot! I'm making my kelihouse here. And the river goes on… wonder who lives further along.

oarsDescription: Well worn, well loved. These have seen a lot of river.
catCaught: Oi! Not by the trousers! All right, I’m going!
catReleased: Put me down, whiskers! Better find a way past without being spotted.

bowlFound: What a pool! A twig ladder, a leaf parasol… fancy enough for a holiday brochure.

seedsFound: Seeds! We can grow flowers, make planters and seed lanterns for our woodland corners.
leavesRest: Let these leaves grow back. There are more plants around the woods.
shellRest: No shells left just now. The shore will bring more in a few hours.
